course_period.name: course_period
course_period.value: "course"."start_date" IS NULL OR "course"."end_date" IS NULL OR "course"."start_date" <= "course"."end_date"

discount_value.name: discount_value
discount_value.value: "discount"."rate_bps" IS NOT NULL OR "discount"."amount_cents" IS NOT NULL

enrollment_manual_price.name: enrollment_manual_price
enrollment_manual_price.value: ("enrollment"."manual_price_cents" IS NULL) = ("enrollment"."price_reason" IS NULL) AND ("enrollment"."manual_price_cents" IS NULL OR "enrollment"."manual_price_cents" >= 0) AND ("enrollment"."price_reason" IS NULL OR btrim("enrollment"."price_reason") <> '')

installment_plan_setting_counts.name: installment_plan_setting_counts
installment_plan_setting_counts.value: cardinality("installment_plan_setting"."counts") BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND array_position("installment_plan_setting"."counts", NULL) IS NULL AND 1 <= ALL("installment_plan_setting"."counts") AND 12 >= ALL("installment_plan_setting"."counts")

invitation_email_code.name: invitation_email_code
invitation_email_code.value: ("invitation"."email_code_hash" IS NULL) = ("invitation"."email_code_sent_at" IS NULL) AND ("invitation"."email_code_hash" IS NULL OR "invitation"."type" = 'invitation')

invitation_content.name: invitation_content
invitation_content.value: ("invitation"."type" = 'invitation' AND "invitation"."role" IS NOT NULL) OR ("invitation"."type" = 'reset' AND "invitation"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

invoice_one_draft.name: invoice_one_draft
invoice_one_draft.where: "invoice"."status" = 'to_send' AND "invoice"."attempts" = 0 AND "invoice"."credit_note_of" IS NULL AND "invoice"."season_id" IS NOT NULL

invoice_number_status.name: invoice_number_status
invoice_number_status.value: ("invoice"."status" <> 'to_send' OR "invoice"."number" IS NULL) AND ("invoice"."status" <> 'issued' OR ("invoice"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "invoice"."issued_on" IS NOT NULL))
